assets.title: Daily Check-in
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: static mini promotional banner for the existing Jito Gaming website. Exact canvas 1983 x 793 pixels, wide 2.5:1, full bleed. It will display as one of THREE small cards in a row, approximately 156x62 CSS pixels desktop or 114x46 mobile, so use extremely strong hierarchy, huge simple type and a single bold visual grouping, few details, no tiny body copy. Premium dimensional 3D finish matching cinematic burgundy/gold Jito banners, broad glossy highlights, crisp silhouettes, restrained depth. Dark burgundy #681C32 anchors the design, champagne gold gives brand consistency. No CTA button, no outer frame, no rounded-corner mockup, no watermark, no extra claims, no fine ornamental filigree. Keep copy in safe area with 6% horizontal margins; readable contrast at thumbnail size.
Subject and composition: left 64% is typography on a deep burgundy-to-dark-teal ground. On the right 36% a large sculpted red enamel desk-calendar icon, champagne-gold binding rings and bevels, a broad ivory/champagne calendar page with ONE oversized emerald checkmark. No dates or extra writing on the calendar. A few large simple check marks on subtle tiles can suggest progress behind it, but no tiny grids. Teal #46B8A5 rim lighting and a softly defocused teal glow distinguish the background.
Text EXACTLY: "DAILY CHECK-IN" as one short, bold warm champagne uppercase header near upper left; below it "7 DAYS" very large, with the 7 the largest element in bright champagne gold and DAYS in pale teal/ivory. Tight balanced horizontal grouping, robust bold condensed lettering, smooth bevels, minimal extrusion. The 7 DAYS line should dominate the card. No other text or numbers, no money, no chest or gift box. Finished static artwork only.
